note: Thirteen primitive camping spots scattered over a large area on the Chariton River, nearly all of them a small gravel lot beside a road. The one real camp is near the area headquarters yard off Route N: a gravel loop around a mown lawn with shade trees and a privy. From there the area's gravel road goes on to a concrete boat ramp on the river (a large gravel lot, about a quarter mile north) and ends about a mile north-east at a lot with a privy on the river bank. No pads, tables or water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites' - 13 Camping site symbols on the map, each beside a Parking symbol, and 13 GIS camping points. Free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. Phone matches the area page. The pin is on a minor lot at the far east edge; the main camp is the loop by the headquarters yard 3.3 km west-south-west - pin move flagged. Not waterfront stands for the main camp.
flags: INCLUSION (lot rule - stays): the area page lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites' (and walk-in open camping); the brochure says 'Camping is allowed on or adjacent to all area parking lots. No unattended open campfires allowed. Stays are limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period.' That is parking-lot wording, but MDC marks a designated camping point at each lot (13 map symbols, 13 GIS 'Primitive Camping Area' points) and one of them is a built camp loop with a privy, so under the 2026-11-09 rule it stays. No horse camp is labelled.

PIN MOVE (main camp): stored 40.56656,-92.66905 is GIS point 558, a small pull-in under trees on the road at the area's far east edge. The main camp is GIS point 307 at 40.55487,-92.70460: on the leaf-off frame a gravel loop about 60 x 50 m around a mown lawn with scattered trees and a privy on its south side, a vehicle parked on the loop, with MDC's equipment yard just east of it. The map puts a privy, a camping symbol and a parking symbol together there. Move the pin to 40.55487,-92.70460 (3.3 km west-south-west of the stored pin).

CLUSTERS: (a) main gravel road in from Route N on the south-west side, one entrance: 548 at 40.55390,-92.71176 (roadside pull-out), 307 the camp loop, 551 at 40.55877,-92.70160 (gravel lot about 45 x 25 m at the concrete boat ramp, 450 m north of the loop), 556 at 40.56451,-92.68921 (road-end gravel lot with a privy on the south bank, about 1.5 km north-east of the loop by the same road). (b) north bank and east side, reached from Raven Road: 555 at 40.56658,-92.69032 (point in timber on the hillside; its lot is on the north-bank road at 40.56507,-92.68895, directly across an old bridge from 556), 558 the stored pin, 554 at 40.56405,-92.69845 (point in timber, a gravel lot about 25 x 12 m 70 m south-east). (c) singles on their own roads: 557 at 40.55368,-92.67436 (roadside lot in old field, Scenic Drive), 553 at 40.56978,-92.71043 (lot with a privy and viewing platform on the edge of a large managed marsh pool), 552 at 40.56508,-92.72528 (lot about 35 x 12 m with a privy, west side), 549 at 40.55260,-92.72549 (road-end lot), 550 at 40.54105,-92.72265 (point in timber, its lot about 190 m south), 559 at 40.53789,-92.70462 (boat-ramp lot on the river at 135th Street, south edge). NO SPLIT proposed: everything in (a) shares the Route N entrance, and every outlying spot is a single small lot.

RIVER IN VIEW: not from the main camp loop (the river is about 450 m north, beyond fields and timber). Three lots are on the bank: 556 (lot edge about 25 m from the water through a band of bank trees; channel about 20 m wide), 551 (the boat-ramp lot, north edge about 15 m from the water, the ramp beside it) and 559 (the 135th Street ramp lot, about 20-30 m from the water; channel about 25 m). All three are ramp or road-end lots, so stored not waterfront stands for the entry; 556 would be the one to name if the pin were ever put on the river.

ACCESS: 'From Livonia, take Route N north 4.60 miles.' The map legend shows only 'Unimproved Road' and service roads inside the area; on imagery the road to the loop, the ramp and the river lot is ordinary graded gravel. No low-water crossing, 4WD wording or posted limit on the page, brochure or map. River bottom land: the ramp and river lots will flood. OSM was unread (the Overpass mirror timed out).
PHONE: stored 660-785-2420 matches the area page's 'For more information call (660) 785-2420'.
SEASON: stored year_round (manual) stands; the brochure gives no camping season for the lots (walk-in camping is shut out during firearms deer and turkey seasons).
